explanation: Both were founded in Paris: the IOC at the Sorbonne in June 1894, two years before the first modern Olympics, and FIFA a decade later, in May 1904.

claims.text: The International Olympic Committee was founded in Paris on 23 June 1894, at a congress held at the Sorbonne.
FIFA was founded in Paris on 21 May 1904.
The first modern Olympic Games were held in Athens in 1896.
